footer.statement: An independent community initiative. Not an official government website.

budgetLanguageNote: The budget pages are available in English.

home.title: BetterCarmona
home.heading: Find City of Carmona services and public information
home.intro: A community guide run by a volunteer. This is not the city government's website.

hotlines.title: Emergency hotlines
hotlines.source: The city's official list of health, disaster, police, and fire numbers, posted June 2024. Opens on the city's website.

services.heading: What do you need to do?
services.note: These links leave BetterCarmona and open the city's own websites. We took them from the official portal and last checked them on {{date}}.

transparency.heading: Budget transparency
transparency.body: See the national budget lines that name Carmona. The amounts are as published in the budget documents, not spending.

who.heading: Who runs this site
who.body: BetterCarmona is run by Carlo Lim, a private citizen, as a volunteer. It is not affiliated with the City Government of Carmona, and it does not speak for the city.
who.official: For official information and transactions, go to the city directly:

sources.heading: How facts are sourced
sources.body: Officials, hotlines, fees, and documents on this site show their source and the date we recorded them. If we can't find a source for a fact, we leave it out.
sources.check: Official information can change after we record it, so check with the office concerned before you act on it.
sources.budget: Budget figures come from the BetterGov.ph Budget API. They are amounts as published, not spending.

errors.heading: Report an error
errors.body: If something here is wrong or out of date, open an issue on GitHub. Tell us which page it's on, what looks wrong, and where the correct information can be found.
errors.note: You'll need a free GitHub account. Issues are public, so leave out personal details. We can't act on requests for city services, so please bring those to the city.

directory.heading: Better LGU Directory
directory.body: BetterCarmona is listed in the Better LGU Directory, a community-maintained list of Better LGU portals across the Philippines. This site's code is public too.
